description: Source-legislation corpus manifest for the Australian legal RAG knowledge base. Each entry is a primary instrument cited by the 50-item evaluation set (datasets/legal/processed/eval-legal-au.jsonl), mapped to the evaluation category it grounds. The corpus text in text/ is COMMITTED to the repository (not regenerated) so every run is repeatable and every recorded score is reproducible; each entry below pins the exact version used plus a SHA-256 of the committed bytes. Register IDs were resolved and verified against the Federal Register of Legislation OData API (api.prod.legislation.gov.au). Do not hand-edit IDs; re-resolve with the collector's --verify flag. Full human-readable provenance, licensing and processing notes: SOURCES.md.

processing.note: The committed text is a PROCESSED copy, not an authorised version of the law. Commonwealth Acts are the authorised Word compilation volumes converted to plain text with tables of contents removed; NSW Acts are statute text extracted from saved HTML with site chrome discarded. For authoritative text use the version_url on each entry. See SOURCES.md.

pinning.policy: Each instrument below is pinned to the compilation/version actually committed. The collector currently ALWAYS resolves the newest compilation, so re-running `collect-corpus.py` over this corpus would overwrite pinned text with newer law and silently invalidate every measured result. Treat `collect-corpus.py` (without --verify) as a re-pinning operation, not a refresh: run it deliberately, then update compilation_date / compilation_number / sha256 here and re-measure.
pinning.verify_digests: See SOURCES.md for a stdlib snippet that checks text/ against the sha256 values below.

instruments.title: Corporations Act 2001
instruments.key_provisions: s180-184 (directors' duties), s1043A (insider trading), s588G (insolvent trading)
instruments.notes: Largest instrument - 7 download volumes. Chunking matters for retrieval quality. Volumes 6-7 (Schedules 2/3/4 + endnotes) arrived with the 2026-08-27 compilation and grew the file 45%.

instruments.title: Commonwealth of Australia Constitution Act
instruments.notes: Collection 'Constitution' (Q-series id), not 'Act'. Compilation 6 of 1977 IS current - the last amendment by referendum was Act No. 84 of 1977, so the old date is correct, not stale.

instruments.title: Administrative Appeals Tribunal Act 1975
instruments.notes: REPEALED 14 Oct 2024, replaced by the Administrative Review Tribunal Act 2024 (repeal via C2024A00038), so compilation 54 is the final one. CURRENCY FLAG: an eval item references the AAT. Kept in corpus for that item, but the underlying question may be stale - flag for the dataset currency review, and consider adding the Administrative Review Tribunal Act 2024 if the eval item is refreshed.

instruments.title: Succession Act 2006
instruments.notes: NSW state law - not on the federal register. Collected manually (bot challenge blocks automation; see MANUAL_NSW in collect-corpus.py). Part 2 (making of wills). version_date is null because the NSW 'Current version for <date> to date' banner sits in the page chrome the extractor discards; the sha256 pins the bytes and latest_amendment_in_text is a verifiable lower bound. version_url is unverified - the domain 403s automated checks.
